title: Uniform loss-free estimate

statement.text: Prove or refute that every admissible object satisfies the stated loss-free estimate with a constant independent of the discretization parameter.
statement.formal_quantifier_outline: forall N and admissible X_N, A_N(X_N) <= C B_N(X_N), where C is independent of N

hypotheses: all normalization and regularity assumptions are fixed here
conclusion: a uniform constant C exists without the classical logarithmic loss

success_criteria.proof: Complete deductive proof of the exact uniform estimate
success_criteria.refutation: Exact admissible family for which the uniform estimate fails
